scripts.dev:cloudflare: npm run cloudflare && wrangler dev worker.js
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run cloudflare && wrangler deploy worker.js
scripts.preview:cloudflare: npm run cloudflare && wrangler preview worker.js
scripts.check: npm run nearley && svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./jsconfig.json
scripts.check:watch: npm run nearley && svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./jsconfig.json --watch
scripts.test:cloudflare-cache: cross-env PUBLIC_BASE_URL=http://localhost GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY=test-google-maps-key GEONAMES_USERNAME=test-geonames-user MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN=test-mapbox-token npm run cloudflare && node --test tests/cloudflare-cache.test.js
scripts.nearley: node src/lib/grammars/scripts/prepare-input.js && nearleyc src/lib/grammars/main.ne -o src/lib/grammars/generated/main.js && node src/lib/grammars/scripts/modify-output.js
scripts.mobile: npm run static && npx cap sync
scripts.android:dev: export CAPACITOR_ANDROID_STUDIO_PATH="$(which android-studio)" && npm run mobile && npx cap open android
scripts.ios:dev: npm run mobile && npx cap open ios
